subject.title: fix: guard JSON.parse calls against malformed external responses

question: Should this broader malformed-JSON hardening PR land first, or should the OpenRouter hunk be split or delayed behind https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101488?
rationale: The code is focused and correct, but two open branches now touch the same OpenRouter stream parser area for different hardening goals, so maintainers should choose the canonical landing order.

options.title: Land This Batch First
options.body: Land this PR for the three malformed-JSON guards, then require the OpenRouter stream-bounds branch to rebase and preserve the parse guard.

options.title: Split The OpenRouter Hunk
options.body: Keep this PR for docs search and Claude MCP config only if maintainers want https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101488 to own all OpenRouter stream parser edits.

options.title: Pause For OpenRouter Caps
options.body: Wait for the stream-bounds PR decision first, accepting that the docs and Claude MCP parse guards remain unmerged meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Land This Batch First
recommendation.body: Land this PR for the three malformed-JSON guards, then require the OpenRouter stream-bounds branch to rebase and preserve the parse guard.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle appears in history for all three affected areas and is the best routing candidate for the cross-surface landing choice.
